hero.text: I am a programmer driven by curiosity and continuous growth. I transform requirements into high-quality digital experiences, while ensuring solid foundations in the craft of programming. My long-term goal is to immerse myself in the world of cybersecurity and achieve expertise in this field, while remaining open to diverse areas of the digital world.

items.desc: My work involved developing medical software and co-creating a user interface based on Angular for a gas storage management system, focusing on optimizing data loading and close collaboration with back-end and UX/UI teams.

I co-created medical software for clinics and hospitals, contributing to backend and frontend components, as well as a cross-platform mobile app. I worked closely with the team to ensure reliability, usability, and practicality for healthcare professionals.

I co-developed software for a disinfecting robot and dosimeters. Later, I contributed to a client-server application for a glass manufacturing company, enabling teams to monitor and analyze production statistics.

Developed as an Engineering Thesis, this project integrates embedded systems, software engineering, and electronics. It features a fully automated smart home scale model, with hardware interfacing a central control system managing real-time environmental data and automation logic.
